messages:
maria_cs: Morning — quick async standup for DriftWave renewal/escalation.

What I did: Handed off incident to eng, escalated to tier-2, notified account exec (Olivia).
Blockers: Customer seeing duplicate embeds after retry surge; webhook retries spike -> renewal risk if not stabilized before EOW.
Today: Need an ETA on fix, can an eng take code review + patch? Also need guidance on reducing retry window on their side (we can suggest config).
PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/driftwave-integration/pull/452

cc @sam_eng @jordan_se @lee_sre :thumbsup:

sam_eng: on it. I'll review #452 now. initial look seems like a race in the dedupe cache TTL.
I'll try a hotfix to shorten KV lock hold time and add idempotency token check.
ETA: aim for PR by 10:30 PT. If that's risky, I'll open a revertable canary.

jordan_se: FYI I pushed a small telemetry change to log `retry_count` and `client_id` in debug traces — helps postmortem.
Link: https://logs.internal/redwood/xyz

lee_sre: I can drop the retry backoff on the infra side to buy time. Suggest changing from `backoff_ms: [100, 200, 400]` to `[50,100,200]` for DriftWave only.
I'll coordinate with netops.

olivia_pm: I'm on the renewal call at 3pm PT. Please flag me with a short summary when we have an ETA. Customer is sensitive to downtime language.

maria_cs: thanks. Quick ask for docs team — can we draft a one-paragraph note for the account about recommended retry config? keep it simple.

sam_eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/driftwave-integration/pull/452/files — tests added. @deploy-bot can you run canary pipeline when approved?

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued for PR 452. Started run c-2026-03-17-09. Notifying @lee_sre on completion.

maria_cs: Perfect. If canary looks clean, let's schedule a quick deploy before Olivia's call. If not, we need a rollback path documented — @jordan_se pls post rollback steps.

jordan_se: rollback is one-liner: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/driftwave-proxy --to-revision=3` — will paste into the ticket.
